specification.scope: Post hoc frozen-list analysis of previously accessible 2018–2021 outcomes, not independent confirmation or 2022 extension

legacy.battery: Exact recorded original_q30 and its realized-coverage matched selection; old supply-capped rule preserved
legacy.electronics: Recorded fixed_core9_pair3 and fixed_core9; aliases of B09_m03 and B09_m00

invariants: Exact same identifiers for nonbinding within-C floor
Same noncore identifiers at fixed C
All entries unfamiliar core and all removals familiar core at fixed C
Reconstruct all recorded U and legacy+match task/general/novel/core counts
specification.intervention_known_at_origin: r=max(0,m-novel_count_B(C)); outcome not used to define contexts or binding
specification.coverage_direction: Sign(C-C0): expansion, unchanged or contraction, keep every predefined C; no independent inference from stacked allocation cells
specification.binding_states: all, binding, nonbinding for within-allocation contrasts; all predefined original contexts retained including empty groups
specification.ratio: sum(net task/general selected-document gain)/sum(introduced document events), missing when denominator zero; not future benefit per actual hour
specification.goal_dominance: Per-situation observed choices only; mean comparison on common support of U,B9m0,B9m3,C6m3,C12m3,legacy,legacy_match,title,priority; not global Pareto or deployed policy
specification.feasibility: Exact C and m, no capping. Every rejected cell retains all supply shortages; electronics prior exclusion leaves only existing admitted 1077 pools plus 5 admission failures with no cached pools

uncertainty.organization: paired resampling with all focal organization years together; percentile ranges
uncertainty.crossed: Fixed lists, independent organization and patent Exp(1) product multipliers. Net gain mean denominator complete pool exposure 1/pool_n; ratio denominator introduced-event indicators
uncertainty.scope: Overall allocation to9, fixed-C9 novelty, fixed-m3 coverage6to12 and legacy within-match; novelty+legacy also binding-only. Sparse contexts descriptive only
uncertainty.interpretation: Crossed uncertainty is dependence sensitivity, no established exact coverage claim
